# Learned instinct: gitlab-no-deploy-on-push (confidence 0.95)

Deployment to test, staging, or production must never be triggered automatically on push. Deployment jobs must use `when: manual` or an Octopus Deploy lifecycle gate. Automated promotion past Dev without human approval violates the orchestrator's hard rule (propose, never dispose) and PCI Req 6.5 change control.

Source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 6.5; infra-ops CLAUDE.md hard rule #1
